description: Reviewed, locally tracked adaptation of AtlasOS playbook tweaks. Security-reducing and constraint-violating AtlasOS items (Defender/VBS/mitigations, disabling Windows Update, Edge removal, NetBT/UCPD, UAC secure desktop, NIC driver registry tweaks, BCD boot-menu changes, 8.3-name disabling, AutoEndTasks) are deliberately excluded.

registryUser.name: MouseSpeed
registryUser.rationale: 1:1 mouse pointer, no acceleration (AtlasOS gaming default).

registryUser.name: MouseThreshold1
registryUser.rationale: No first acceleration threshold (AtlasOS gaming default).

registryUser.name: MouseThreshold2
registryUser.rationale: No second acceleration threshold (AtlasOS gaming default).

registryUser.name: FontSmoothing
registryUser.rationale: Keep font smoothing while trimming other visual effects.

registryUser.name: DragFullWindows
registryUser.rationale: Keep full-content window drag while trimming other visual effects.

registryUser.name: UserPreferencesMask
registryUser.rationale: Visual-effects bitmask: keep smoothing/drag, kill window animation.

registryUser.name: VisualFXSetting
registryUser.rationale: Custom visual-effects preset so the per-item choices above stick.

registryUser.name: HungAppTimeout
registryUser.rationale: Treat apps as hung after 2s at shutdown; AtlasOS AutoEndTasks=1 is deliberately excluded (force-closes apps without save prompts).

registryUser.name: WaitToKillAppTimeOut
registryUser.rationale: Wait only 2s for apps to exit at shutdown/logoff.

registryMachine.name: SystemResponsiveness
registryMachine.rationale: MMCSS: reserve only 10% CPU for background multimedia tasks (gaming).

registryMachine.name: Win32PrioritySeparation
registryMachine.rationale: Short variable quantum with foreground boost (gaming/desktop).

registryMachine.name: DisablePagingExecutive
registryMachine.rationale: Keep drivers and kernel in RAM (safe on 64GB).

registryMachine.name: DisablePageCombining
registryMachine.rationale: Disable page combining to cut CPU overhead (safe on 64GB).

registryMachine.name: Enabled
registryMachine.rationale: Disable Fault Tolerant Heap per-app crash mitigations (perf).

registryMachine.name: WakeUp
registryMachine.rationale: Automatic maintenance never wakes the PC.

registryMachine.name: EnableMulticast
registryMachine.rationale: Disable LLMNR (replaced by DNS; attack surface).

registryMachine.name: DisableWpbtExecution
registryMachine.rationale: Block firmware WPBT-injected OEM binaries (ASUS bloat vector).

registryMachine.name: AUPowerManagement
registryMachine.rationale: Updates stay enabled but never wake the PC to install.

registryMachine.name: NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers
registryMachine.rationale: Updates stay enabled but never force-reboot over a logged-on user (the only Windows Update change).

machineActions.rationale: Group services back into shared svchost processes (AtlasOS): lower process count/RAM on a 64GB machine.
Stop Modern Standby SleepStudy diagnostic logging (AtlasOS).
